title: 29 Sept-Youth Month Program - Essay Competition
summary: 29th September – Essay Writing Competition in English, Hindi and Marathi at Aryan High School (Junior and Senior Students), Girgaum.
description:
29th September – Essay Writing Competition in English, Hindi and Marathi at Aryan High School (Junior and Senior Students), Girgaum.
Day 2 of Youth Month saw a wonderful response to our Essay Writing Competition, with 179 students putting their thoughts, imagination and perspectives on paper. The competition was conducted in English, Hindi and Marathi, giving students the opportunity to express themselves in the language they were most comfortable with.
A banana and biscuit pack was distributed to all the participating students as a small gesture of appreciation.
Project cost Rs 15,000/-
